europe_now.title: EU budget deadlock at summit
europe_now.summary: European Union leaders concluded a tense summit without reaching an agreement on the upcoming multi-year budget. Divisions persisted among member states over spending priorities and financial allocations.

sources.headline: EU: Leaders fail to reach agreement on next budget after tense summit
EU leaders fail to bridge budget splits as talks stall

europe_now.title: Spanish general election campaign focuses on housing and immigration
europe_now.summary: The final debate ahead of Spain's upcoming general election was heavily dominated by discussions regarding the national housing crisis and immigration policies. Political leaders clashed over potential solutions as voters prepared to head to the polls.

sources.headline: Spain election: Housing crisis and immigration dominate final campaign debate
Leaders clash in final Spain election debate as housing dominates run-in

top_stories.title: EU Financial and Institutional Negotiations
top_stories.summary: European leaders failed to finalize the bloc's budget following a tense meeting in Brussels. Officials from France and Germany are pressing for a comprehensive agreement before the end of the year to safeguard ongoing commitments.

sources.headline: EU: Leaders fail to reach agreement on next budget after tense summit

top_stories.title: Spanish Electoral Campaign Developments
top_stories.summary: The final televised debate for Spain's general election centered primarily on severe housing shortages and immigration pressures. Voters and political parties continue to debate the economic impacts and policy directions ahead of the vote.

sources.headline: Spain election: Housing crisis and immigration dominate final campaign debate

top_stories.title: Polish Judicial Controversies
top_stories.summary: Poland's disputed constitutional court announced a twelve-month suspension of its chief justice. Meanwhile, a local court overturned a municipal ban preventing demonstrations outside the tribunal building.
